cases.title: Centered impact / shell energy transport
cases.equations: m r¨ = Fspring + Fdamp + Fcontact; E0 = Kprojectile + Kshell + U + Q + Econtact + residual
cases.question: Reference impact; track contact penetration, projectile kinetic energy, structural energy and energy closure.
cases.measurements: Peak overlap; projectile rebound; peak shell kinetic energy; residual magnitude.
cases.limitations: Mesh/timestep sensitivity and conservation checks; contact is penalty-based, not experimentally calibrated.

cases.title: Off-axis versus polar impact
cases.equations: Fcontact = kc max(0,δ)n; τ = r × F; Δp = ∫F dt
cases.question: Compare impact location and asymmetric load transfer; polar and off-axis histories are stored.
cases.measurements: Contact overlap; peak voltage; resistor power; energy residual.
cases.limitations: Cross-case comparability requires checking identical geometry, initial energy and solver settings.

cases.title: Passive damping versus adaptive damping
cases.equations: Fd = −c(t) Δv; Q = ∫c(t)(Δv)²dt; cmin ≤ c(t) ≤ cmax
cases.question: Investigate controller-dependent dissipation in the earlier lattice model.
cases.measurements: Damping trajectory; projectile kinetic energy; dissipated heat; residual.
cases.limitations: Earlier lattice model is not the Stage 12 hemispherical solver; avoid cross-model causal claims.

cases.title: Electromechanical recovery and load coupling
cases.equations: m x¨+c x˙+kx+θV=F; C V˙+V/R=θx˙; E_R=∫V²/R dt
cases.question: Quantify reduced-order electrical port behavior and load energy under impact.
cases.measurements: Resistor power; resistor energy; capacitor energy; max voltage.
cases.limitations: Idealized transducer/storage model; no measured device efficiency or power electronics losses.

cases.title: Deployment under force and power limits
cases.question: Evaluate prescribed flat-to-dome motion against illustrative actuator constraints.
cases.measurements: Peak power; peak force; positive work; feasible flag.
cases.limitations: Archived scan exceeds illustrative limits; this is a negative feasibility result.

cases.title: Geometry, timestep and coupling comparison
cases.question: Compare matched configurations, integration steps and electrical coupling assumptions.
cases.measurements: Stored electrical energy; final speed; energy residual; timestep differences.
cases.limitations: A limited numerical comparison is not proof of mesh convergence.

cases.title: Coupling sensitivity and electrical output
cases.question: Parameter sweep over coupling and integration timestep, using existing CSV output.
cases.measurements: Final velocity; electrical output; stored energy; storage residual.
cases.limitations: Sensitivity within simulated parameter ranges only; not experimentally identified parameters.

cases.title: Mesh refinement / discretization error
cases.equations: e_h=|q_h−q_h/2|; p≈log2(e_h/e_h/2) when three resolutions exist
cases.question: Inspect recorded coarse/fine differences and determine which convergence claims are supported.
cases.measurements: Velocity difference; electrical energy difference; coarse/fine energy residual.
cases.limitations: Only available refinement comparisons are reported; no invented convergence order.

cases.title: Sequential impacts and load accumulation
cases.equations: m r¨ = Fint + Σk Fcontact,k; D=Σcycle g(εmax,Δε) [requires chosen damage law]
cases.question: Proposed repeat-impact experiment with controlled inter-impact timing and load history.
cases.measurements: Peak force per impact; residual deformation; accumulated dissipation.
cases.limitations: No validated damage model or archived sequential-impact dataset is supplied.

cases.title: Spatial stiffness and damping allocation
cases.equations: min_{k,c} [w1 Fpeak+w2 umax+w3 mass] subject to kmin≤k≤kmax, c≥0
cases.question: Proposed distribution study on a constrained shell network with identical projectile energy.
cases.measurements: Pareto trade-offs; force histories; local deformation; parameter maps.
cases.limitations: Requires optimizer, gradient checks and repeated forward solves; not yet computed.

cases.title: Robustness to uncertain material properties
cases.question: Proposed uncertainty study for material parameters, contact stiffness and damping.
cases.measurements: Replicate distributions; failure rates; confidence intervals; sensitivity rankings.
cases.limitations: Requires defensible input distributions and sufficient samples; no results claimed.

cases.title: Reduced-order surrogate versus full shell solver
cases.equations: M q¨+C q˙+Kq=Bu; q≈Φr a; Mr=ΦrᵀMΦr
cases.question: Proposed speed/accuracy benchmark for modal reduction under localized contact loading.
cases.measurements: Runtime; trajectory error; retained modes; conservation residual.
cases.limitations: Requires basis construction and out-of-sample validation; not yet implemented.

methods.title: Discrete shell topology
methods.description: Triangular hemispherical network, connectivity and equatorial constraints.
methods.verification: Inspect connectivity, isolated nodes, element orientation and mesh sensitivity.

methods.title: Time integration
methods.description: Numerical integration of particle and structural motion.
methods.verification: Compare timestep refinement, stability and energy drift; do not equate integration with validation.

methods.title: Penalty contact
methods.description: Contact response under local overlap; surface-based interaction.
methods.equations: δ=max(0,rp−d); Fn=kc δ n (+ dissipative term where implemented)
methods.verification: Inspect overlap, stiffness sensitivity, contact duration and impulse.

methods.title: Structural transport
methods.description: Wave and energy transport across a 3D connected spring network.
methods.verification: Measure energy partition and transport; node histories required for spatial validation.

methods.title: Damping and control
methods.description: Adaptive dissipation in a reduced lattice model.
methods.verification: Compare matched passive and controlled runs, with actuation/sensing assumptions.

methods.title: Field coupling
methods.description: Phenomenological and SI field-coupling tests, including weak induced-dipole effects.
methods.verification: Check force scale and dimensional consistency; no macroscopic free-standing barrier demonstrated.

methods.title: Piezoelectric coupling
methods.description: Single-mode electromechanical port, resistive load and storage accounting.
methods.verification: Verify electrical/mechanical work balance and parameter sensitivity.

methods.title: Deployment inverse dynamics
methods.description: Prescribed shell deployment with actuator load estimation.
methods.verification: Compare peak force, peak power and work against explicit actuator limits.

methods.title: Energy bookkeeping
methods.verification: Plot residual versus time and step size; report both absolute and relative error.

methods.title: Verification and matched comparisons
methods.description: Comparative numerical studies, sensitivity and regression tests.
methods.verification: Record parameter parity, timestep, solver settings and test coverage.

methods.title: Sparse implicit structural solver
methods.description: Candidate future method for stiffness-dominated networks.
methods.verification: Not in current repository; would need implementation and benchmark.

methods.title: Reduced-order / surrogate model
methods.description: Candidate future modal reduction for repeated impact studies.
methods.verification: Not in current repository; no performance claim.
